name: Reconova
summary: Reconova is an AI technology company with an office in Xiamen that develops visual intelligence products and enterprise systems. Its established applications include airports, commercial premises and driver safety. The company is extending its perception and decision technology into embodied robots, including baggage-handling platforms and a wheeled humanoid with two arms.
